item.title: WONDER MAN Posters Reveal A Surprising Status Quo Shift For Superheroes And Tease Doorman's MCU Debut
item.description: Three new posters for Wonder Man reveal a surprising status quo for superpowered individuals in Hollywood, while also confirming that the mutant Doorman will appear in the series.

item.title: Fans Divided By Latest AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY "Leaks" - Are They AI Or A First Look At Steve Rogers' [SPOILER]?
item.description: As another round of Avengers: Doomsday leaks hit social media, the internet is divided over whether these shots of Chris Evans as the MCU's Nomad are the real deal or more AI-generated fakes.

item.title: Netflix Reportedly "Advocating" For A 17-Day Theatrical Window Following Warner Bros. Discovery Deal
item.description: Ted Sarandos recently assured concerned parties that Netflix remains committed to theatrical releases, but that the window would likely "evolve." We now have an update...

item.title: James Gunn Talks MAN OF TOMORROW, Future As DC Studios Co-CEO, Not Caring About A "Best Director" Nomination
item.description: James Gunn has teased Man of Tomorrow while addressing the uncertainty surrounding his future as DC Studios co-CEO. The filmmaker also emphasises that he's not sweating making prestige fare.

item.title: AHSOKA Star [SPOILER] Reportedly Playing MJ's New Love Interest In SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has reportedly added another big name to its cast, with an Ahsoka star rumoured to be playing MJ's (Zendaya) new boyfriend in the upcoming MCU movie.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Ending Spoilers Reveal Two Of AVENGERS: SECRET WARS' Lead Characters
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour claims to reveal how the movie's ending will set the stage for two fan-favourites to take centre stage in next December's Avengers: Secret Wars.

item.title: Introducing FullThrottleHQ.com: A New F1 And Racing Website Joining The ComicBookMovie.com Family!
item.description: A new website is joining the ComicBookMovie.com family, and FullThrottleHQ.com promises to be your new #1 destination for all the biggest Formula 1 updates and results heading into the 2026 season.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: Could As Many As SIX Teaser Trailers Now Be On The Way?
item.description: With the fourth Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer inevitably set to leak online in the coming days, we now have good reason to believe that two more sneak peeks are somewhere on the horizon.

item.title: ANT-MAN Star Evangeline Lilly Reveals Concerning Health Update Following Accident: "I Do Have Brain Damage"
item.description: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania star Evangeline Lilly, who plays Hope Van Dyne in the MCU, has revealed a concerning health update following her recent accident...

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Is Moving Forward With THE FANTASTIC FOUR 2 (And We Know Who They Want To Direct It)
item.description: According to a new report, Marvel Studios is moving forward with a sequel to The Fantastic Four: First Steps for the post-Avengers: Secret Wars MCU, and they already have a director in mind.
